originality.rationale: The published pollen models cover geometric averaged profiles and deposition variability; general residual-allocation theory covers abstract moment formulas. The sharp fixed-mean integer-residence matching interval with equality/nonattainment and specific ecological two-stat inverse were not found in the inspected primary sources or scientific-index comparisons; full limitations and closest-prior implication comparisons are documented. Provisional historical priority.
residual_risks: The generic Jensen/convex-chord and residual-allocation techniques have extensive older mathematical literature; this work does not claim those general lemmas as new.
Earlier inaccessible or unindexed biological mathematical models might have performed the same fixed-mean integer tenure extremization or two-observable parameter inverse.
Biological assumptions of no revisits, one probe and equal pollen fertility are restrictive and not empirically validated.
